newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC raises wheat export goal to EU states.
newsitem.headline: ONIC raises wheat export goal to EU states.

text.p: France's grain office ONIC on Thursday confirmed it had raised by 100,000 tonnes its forecast for soft wheat exports to the European Union for the 1996/97 campaign.
In a new supply/demand report, ONIC put soft wheat exports to other EU states at 8.940 million tonnes against 8.840 million forecast last month and 8.613 million exported in 1995/96.
It kept its target for wheat exports to non-EU states unchanged at 6.0 million tonnes.
France exported 3.75 million tonnes of wheat to non-EU states in 1995/96.
For carryover stocks at end-June 1997, ONIC projected 2.365 million tonnes against 2.297 million in a previous monthly report and 2.230 million at the end of June 1996.
It pegged 1996 soft wheat production at 34.586 million tonnes against 34.352 million estimated last month and 29.825 million produced in 1995.
ONIC raised its forecast for 1996/97 barley exports to other EU countries by 100,000 tonnes to 2.2 million tonnes.
This would compare with 2.244 million tonnes exported to France's EU partners in 1995/96.
ONIC put barley exports to non-EU states at 1.1 million tonnes against 1.2 million forecast last month and the 221,000 exported in 1995/96.
ONIC targeted a barley carryover of 1.375 million tonnes against 1.285 million forecast last month and 629,000 tonnes at the end of June 1996.
It estimated 1996 barley production at 9.488 million tonnes against 9.473 milliion last month and 7.739 in 1995.
It also raised its estimate for 1996/97 maize exports inside the EU by 300,000 tonnes to 5.92 million.
This compares with exports of 6.087 million in 1995/96.
ONIC cut its target for maize exports to non-EU countries by 50,000 tonnes to 200,000 tonnes. France exported 164,000 tonnes of maize to non-EU states in the last season.
ONIC expects France to end the 1996/97 season with a maize carryover of 2.827 million tonnes. This would compare with 2.741 million forecast last month and 1.653 million at end-June, 1996.
ONIC increased its maize output estimate to 13.997 million tonnes from a previous 13.624 million and 1995 production of 12.394 million tonnes.
